notes.title: Surprise! Assemble With Care is now on Android!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36430131/d8174f0268c3373f99b504832957e058e20d63ee.gif[/img]

[h3][b]We're incredibly excited to announce that Assemble With Care is going to be playable and available for more players than ever before, launching on Android devices for the very first time! 🎉[/b][/h3]

With this new release, the game is available entirely [i][b]free to start[/b][/i] - so if you're a big fan of Assemble on Steam, but have never tried the touch controls, download today and check it out!

[b]And by the way, that means Assemble With Care is available for everyone - no Apple Arcade subscription required on mobile any longer.[/b]

We hope these changes will mean more people than ever will discover Assemble With Care! If you're a fan of the game but haven't had a chance to play on mobile, check it out, or let your friends know there's a new way to play!

[b]Check out the trailer here[/b]

[previewyoutube=04i8usL2lF0;full][/previewyoutube]

To download Assemble With Care on IOS or Android - Click here: [u][b]https://go.ustwo.games/awc[/b][/u]

Share your experience with the ustwo games community in Discord:  [u][b]https://go.ustwo.games/discord[/b][/u]

From your friends,

ustwo games
